context.label: Fulfillment
context.description: Choose a line to reserve stock, or a reservation to ship.

alerts.label: Fulfillment exception
alerts.description: Open quantity that neither this order’s reservations nor free stock now cover. Incoming purchase orders are not counted.

presentation.description: Reservation-scoped availability for this item and location. Missing or unavailable data is not zero stock.

actions.label: Reserve stock
actions.description: On hand stays unchanged; available stock decreases.

actions.label: Ship reserved stock
actions.description: On hand and reserved stock decrease by the shipped quantity.

actions.label: Release remainder
actions.description: On hand stays unchanged; the remaining reservation becomes available.

actions.label: Invoice shipped quantities
actions.description: Invoices every shipped quantity not yet invoiced at this order’s prices and tax rates. The first invoice also carries the freight and other fee.

actions.label: Open invoice
actions.description: Open the invoice with its lines, payments and credits.

actions.label: Open packing
actions.description: Open the complete committed shipment document.

documentEditor.saveDescription: Save commits the header and each line in sequence. Drafts do not change stock. Confirm is a separate action, offered once the order has a complete ship-to address (street, city, postal code and country).

create.label: New customer
create.explanation: Creates the customer now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

create.label: New product
create.explanation: Creates the product now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

context.label: Balance
context.description: Record a payment or a credit against this invoice’s balance.

actions.label: Record payment
actions.description: Records a payment received against this invoice. It may not exceed the balance.

actions.label: Issue credit
actions.description: Credits part or all of this invoice’s balance, such as for a return or a price correction.

actions.label: Void invoice
actions.description: Voids this invoice while nothing is paid or credited on it; its quantities can be invoiced again.

actions.label: Open sales order
actions.description: Open the sales order this invoice bills.

context.label: Receiving
context.description: Choose an order line to receive it. Actual cost is entered explicitly; draft editing and Release remain separate.

presentation.description: Reversible is what each line still adds to stock after earlier corrections. Missing or unavailable data is not zero.

actions.label: Receive lines with actual cost
actions.description: Posts one receipt for every line given a quantity, at the actual unit cost and currency you enter. A line left empty is not received.

actions.label: Receive lines with cost explicitly absent
actions.description: Posts one receipt for every line given a quantity, with actual cost explicitly recorded as absent. A line left empty is not received.

actions.label: Reverse receipt
actions.description: Reverses every line of this receipt that still adds to stock, at exactly that quantity, with a posted reversal receipt. Refused if the stock has already left.

actions.label: Receive with actual cost
actions.description: Post received quantity using the actual received cost and currency you enter.

actions.label: Receive with cost explicitly absent
actions.description: Post received quantity with actual cost explicitly recorded as absent. Order price is not received cost.

actions.label: Close open remainder
actions.description: Stops expecting what has not arrived on this line: its ordered quantity becomes the quantity received. Nothing received is changed.

actions.label: Bill received quantities
actions.description: Bills every received quantity not yet billed at this order’s costs and tax rates. The first bill also carries the freight and other fee.

actions.label: Open bill
actions.description: Open the bill with its lines, payments and credits.

actions.label: Open receipt
actions.description: Open the connected receipt and its existing amendment/correction workflow.

documentEditor.saveDescription: Save commits the header and each line in sequence. Drafts do not change stock. Release is a separate action.

create.label: New vendor
create.explanation: Creates the vendor now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

create.label: New product
create.explanation: Creates the product now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

create.label: New vendor
create.explanation: Creates the vendor now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

create.label: New product
create.explanation: Creates the product now as its own record. Saving or discarding this order does not undo it.

context.label: Balance
context.description: Record a payment or a vendor credit against this bill’s balance.

actions.label: Record payment
actions.description: Records a payment made to the vendor against this bill. It may not exceed the balance.

actions.label: Record vendor credit
actions.description: Records a credit the vendor issued against this bill’s balance, such as for a return or a price correction.

actions.label: Void bill
actions.description: Voids this bill while nothing is paid or credited on it; its quantities can be billed again.

actions.label: Open purchase order
actions.description: Open the purchase order this bill bills.

context.label: Customer setup
context.description: Defaults a new sales order takes when this party is its customer, and the addresses it ships to.

presentation.description: Pallets, kegs and crates out with this customer or held from this supplier, and the deposit on them.

actions.label: Add role
actions.description: Adds an active role: a customer can be chosen on sales orders, a supplier on purchase orders, and a salesperson on either.

actions.label: Set order defaults
actions.description: New sales orders for this customer start with this currency and these payment terms; each order can still change them.

actions.label: Set default salesperson
actions.description: New sales orders for this customer start with this salesperson; each order can still change it.

actions.label: Set default tax code
actions.description: New sales orders for this customer are taxed by this code; each order and line can still change it.

actions.label: Add ship-to address
actions.description: Adds an address to this customer’s book. An order copies the address it ships to, so a later change here does not alter it.

actions.label: Use as default ship-to
actions.description: New sales orders for this customer start with this ship-to address.

actions.label: Open custody
actions.description: Open the custody record with its events: issue more, record a return, a forfeit or a deposit refund.

actions.label: Issue returnables
actions.description: Starts a custody record of one returnable type and records its first issue with the deposit taken. Stock is not moved. To issue more of a type already in custody, open its record.

context.label: Custody and deposit
context.description: Returnable assets out with a customer or held from a supplier, and the deposit taken on them. Sellable stock is not moved.

actions.label: Issue
actions.description: Records more of this type handed over -- to the customer, or received from the supplier -- and the deposit taken on them at the unit deposit.

actions.label: Return
actions.description: Records assets that came back. It may not exceed what is outstanding; the deposit on them becomes refundable.

actions.label: Forfeit
actions.description: Records assets that will not come back: the deposit on them is kept and is no longer refundable. It may not exceed what is outstanding.

actions.label: Refund deposit
actions.description: Records the deposit paid back on returned assets. It may not exceed what is refundable now.
